raw_response:
*Speaking as myself, an old woman who's been working these fields since I was a girl...*

Aiya, another year. My back isn't what it used to be, but the land doesn't wait. Let me think about what I'll do this year, same as always more or less.

**On the wheat** — I planted it last October, right around the usual time, after the Double Ninth Festival. Put down one bag of compound fertilizer per mu before planting, like I always do. That's what my husband and I have done for years and it hasn't steered us wrong. The field came through winter alright. When it greens up and starts to joint, I'll scatter about half a bag of urea per mu — my neighbor old Wang, his wheat looked yellow last year because he was stingy with the urea, I don't want that. I'll need to water it maybe three times — once after green-up, once at jointing if it's dry, and once when the grain is filling. The well water costs money to pump so I watch the sky first. If it rains enough I skip one.

**On the maize** — right after the wheat combine comes through in early June, we have to hurry. One week, maybe less, before we put the maize in. I buy the hybrid seed, everyone does now, the old varieties don't yield. One bag of compound at planting, then when the maize is about knee-high I put urea around the stalks. Maize doesn't need as much water as wheat if the summer rains come. Usually I irrigate once or twice.

**On money** — 4.1 mu isn't much. My son sends some money from the city but I don't like spending too much on fertilizer all at once. Two bags per mu for the whole year between the two crops, that's what I can manage. If I had more money maybe I'd put on more, but then again my yields have been fine, same as the neighbors.

**On labor** — I do the weeding myself, and my husband helps when his back allows. For the wheat harvest we hire the combine that goes around the village — 60 yuan per mu, everyone pays the same. Same for maize harvest in the fall. Planting the maize we hire the little machine because we can't do it fast enough by hand in that tight window.

**On pests** — I buy a bit of herbicide for the weeds in both crops, the shop owner tells me which bottle. For bugs, usually I don't spray unless I see them eating the leaves. Last year the maize had some borers but not too bad.
